_comment: Multi-turn conversations for the naturalness eval (ROADMAP H10), against restaurant-fixture.json. Each customer turn is answered live by the assistant; the whole transcript is then scored by the LLM judge (NaturalnessJudge.RUBRIC) and every answer is checked by NaturalnessRules. persona overrides the fixture persona for that conversation. minimum: lowest acceptable judge score per criterion for that conversation (default 4). Replace or extend with anonymized pilot conversations.
